title: Gusset Order Form
description: Order form produced by the Claude parser and validated before CAD geometry generation. Enum values and numeric bounds are placeholders pending Peter's review.

part_type.title: Part Type
part_type.description: Discriminator field identifying this order form as a gusset.

tube_size_a.title: Tube Size A
tube_size_a.description: Cross-section of the first MAXTube arm, in inches (width x height).

tube_size_b.title: Tube Size B
tube_size_b.description: Cross-section of the second MAXTube arm, in inches (width x height).

angle_deg.title: Angle (degrees)
angle_deg.description: Interior angle between the two tube arms, in degrees.

holes_per_side.title: Holes Per Side
holes_per_side.description: Number of mounting holes on each arm of the gusset.

hole_spec.title: Hole Specification
hole_spec.description: Fastener size the holes are sized for.

hole_pattern.title: Hole Pattern
hole_pattern.description: Layout rule for hole placement along each arm.

thickness_in.title: Thickness (inches)
thickness_in.description: Material thickness of the gusset plate, in inches.

pocketed.title: Pocketed
pocketed.description: Whether the gusset face is pocketed (weight-reduction cutouts).
